reference_summaries.summary: Square, richly packed illustrated cover showing a warm sunroom/lounge filled with oversized houseplants, pumpkins, furniture, hanging planters and leafy views through broad windows. It uses a bold dark outline, rounded stylised forms, autumn orange-brown-gold colouring and large white bubble display lettering at the top.

Portrait-format illustrated cover with a centered outdoor café/cottage vignette. A simply drawn seated person holding a drink is surrounded by pumpkins, fallen leaves, a fruit basket, tree, lanterns and a storefront; very large rounded orange headline lettering dominates the upper half. The treatment has strong black outlines, textured warm colouring and a friendly cozy-storybook feel.

Square illustrated Halloween cover framed as a wooden theatre/window opening. Small cute ghost-like and pumpkin-like characters gather around a cauldron, with candles, bats, stars and candy-themed details. It combines thick rounded outlines, compact chibi figures, dark navy negative space, warm orange glow effects and large white bubble lettering.

illustration_category: Whimsical, cozy seasonal colouring-book cover illustration with cartoon storybook scene-building; the references are presented as fully coloured promotional covers rather than interior colouring pages.
line_weight: Prominent dark brown-to-black outer contours, approximately 3–6 px at the shown cover scale; inner details use thinner but still clearly legible dark outlines. Lines are mostly uniform, with occasional slightly thicker silhouette edges; no delicate engraving or hatching-heavy linework.
line_smoothness: Smooth, rounded, digitally clean contours with mildly hand-drawn irregularity in small texture and detail marks.
level_of_detail: Medium to high cover-level detail. Each scene has many individually readable cozy props, plants, leaves and seasonal motifs, but large foreground shapes and clear outlines keep the imagery accessible.
shape_language: Soft, bulbous and approachable forms: rounded pumpkins, plump leaves, curved furniture, chunky pots, scalloped awnings and simplified organic foliage. Architectural structures are also softened with rounded corners and gently uneven hand-drawn edges.
character_proportions: When characters appear, they have simplified cartoon/chibi proportions: large rounded heads or body masses, short limbs, compact silhouettes and minimal anatomical complexity. The seated human figure is more natural than chibi but remains stylised with a relatively large head and simplified hands.
facial_simplicity: Very simple, cute facial treatment: dot or small oval eyes, tiny curved mouths, sparse blush/freckle marks and little to no realistic facial modelling. The human face uses minimal dots and curved features rather than detailed anatomy.
composition_density: High but organized density. A central hero scene is surrounded by themed supporting objects, with foreground props overlapping the main setting. Cover typography occupies a strong dedicated upper zone, while plants, pumpkins, leaves or small icons fill gaps without leaving large empty areas.
whitespace: Limited whitespace within the illustrated cover area. Breathing room is created through broad wall, sky or dark-night areas behind headline text and around focal figures, not through blank page space.
background_complexity: Fully illustrated, scene-based backgrounds. Reference 1 uses a detailed indoor conservatory with windows; reference 2 uses a cottage café exterior; reference 3 uses a dark night-sky backdrop within a wooden stage-like frame. Backgrounds include layered environmental details but remain subordinate to the central focal scene.
typography: Large, playful rounded display lettering is placed prominently at the top, usually in uppercase. Main titles use thick white or autumn-orange fills with heavy dark outlines; secondary subtitles use compact bold uppercase sans-serif lettering. Small page-count badges and logo-like marks appear as additional cover graphics.
orientation_layout: A mix of square cover layouts (references 1 and 3) and a portrait cover layout (reference 2). Each is vertically structured: headline at top, a centered seasonal vignette in the middle, and foreground objects or a circular information badge near the bottom.
perspective: Simple front-facing or shallow three-quarter storybook perspective. Objects are stacked in layered foreground/middle/background planes rather than built with strict realistic perspective; interiors and storefronts use mild converging lines for depth.
colour_behaviour: Warm autumn hues dominate: pumpkin orange, rust, ochre, golden yellow, muted olive and earthy brown. Dark charcoal/navy is used sparingly for contrast, especially in the Halloween scene. Colours are contained by dark outlines and use several tonal variations within major objects.
palette_characteristics: Cozy, earthy, saturated-but-muted fall palette with cream highlights and deep dark accents. The Halloween reference shifts to a navy, brown and orange palette while retaining warm candlelit highlights. Overall palette is harmonious and seasonal rather than neon-bright.
contrast: Moderate to high contrast. Dark outlines clearly separate all objects; pale cream/white title fills and golden highlights stand out against warm or dark backgrounds. Focal items receive the clearest tonal separation.
shading_approach: Soft cel-shading combined with subtle painterly texture. Shadows are usually placed as simple darker colour regions beneath overlaps and along edges; warm rim light, small speckles, and glow around candles or windows add atmosphere. Avoid complex realism.
texture: Noticeable lightly grainy paper/paint texture across coloured fills, plus tiny flecks, stipple-like highlights and occasional mottled tonal variation. This texture enriches cover art but is not required for clean black-and-white colouring interiors.
emotional_tone: Warm, nostalgic, gentle and inviting; cozy domestic autumn comfort with a lightly playful, non-threatening spooky mood in the Halloween example.
apparent_audience: The simplified cute forms and bold, easy-to-read visual hierarchy suggest broad family-friendly appeal, likely including children and adults who enjoy relaxing cute/cozy seasonal colouring themes.
printable_suitability: The bold outlines, large recognizable shapes and clear focal scenes translate well to home-printable colouring pages if simplified into black line art. For an autumn colouring book, retain generous open fill areas, avoid the cover references' dense micro-texture and heavy dark colour fills, and keep fine plant veins, wood grain and tiny decor to a controlled level so pages remain easy to colour and print clearly.
